verdict.rationale: Zero documents AI-assisted composition, and its founder says it drafts replies, so AI reply drafting exists. Nothing shows the drafts are tuned to the user's own voice or tone rather than generic output, and a review-before-send flow is only implied by draft creation. missing for 10: evidence of voice/tone personalization (learning from the user's sent mail or style), a documented review-and-send workflow for AI drafts, independent hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
